name: Weeb Central
_todo: FIXED (2026-09-19): offset math was previously using {page} directly as the offset (page=1 -> offset=1), which is wrong for a 0-indexed offset API and caused real queries to return wrong/empty results (confirmed live: 'Kagurabachi' search returned nothing at offset=1 despite genuinely existing on the site, worked correctly at offset=0). Runtime now computes offset=(page-1)*32 and substitutes {offset} separately from {page}.

Chapter list is NOT at {manga_url} -- the real flow extracts a numeric seriesId from the manga URL's second path segment, then fetches GET /series/{seriesId}/full-chapter-list separately. Verified via curl against the real live site (2026-09-19): this endpoint DOES respond 200 with real headers (cloudflare, not blocked), but the body is only a 300-500 byte 'back to top' fragment with no chapter data, even with cookies/referer/UA/compression negotiation set to match a real browser. The real Kotlin extension calls this same URL successfully, so something in the real request (likely a specific header, or the app's OkHttp client doing something curl doesn't) is missing -- this endpoint is CONFIRMED NOT WORKING as currently specified, not just unverified. fetchChapterList against a real manga will return an empty list until this is debugged further.

Popular/search manga_list_item selectors (article > section > a, div:not([class]) title, self/href url, img/src cover) WERE verified against real live HTML fetched 2026-09-19 -- 32/32 popular items and a real 1/1 match for a live 'Kagurabachi' search correctly parsed with real titles/URLs/covers using a local htmlparser.lua test harness, not guessed.

Page list needs baseUrl + chapter path + '/images?is_prev=False&reading_style=long_strip' appended, not the raw chapter URL -- approximated below by folding those query params into the endpoint template's static path, assuming {chapter_url} is a path (not a full URL with its own query string already). NOT live-tested since chapter_list doesn't return real chapters yet (see above).

Real extension sets custom image request headers (Accept: image/avif,image/webp,*/*, Host: <image host>) and removes the default Origin header entirely -- this schema's client.extra_headers only supports static addition, not removal, and page-image fetches reuse the general 'client' headers rather than per-image overrides. Images may fail to load if weebcentral's CDN enforces those headers strictly.

Rate limited to 1 request per 2 seconds by the real extension (HTTP 429 was a real reported bug at higher rates) -- this schema has no rate_limit field, so a naive scraper here risks 429s that the real Kotlin extension avoids.
